title: Skin Care for Pune Weather: A Routine for Monsoon, Dry Heat and Cool Winters
ex: A long damp monsoon, dry hot summers and cool dry winters: how to keep one simple skin care routine for Pune weather and adjust it by season.
rt: Skin Care for Pune Weather: Routine by Season | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Pune weather: a simple routine for the long monsoon, dry summer sun, cool winter nights, bike commutes, AC offices and hostel water.
quick: Pune is humid in the monsoon and dry for most of the rest of the year, with cool winter nights. Keep one routine of gentle face wash, light moisturiser, daily sunscreen and night cream, using about half the cream in the monsoon and a full pea-sized amount from November.
facts: Pune sits on the Deccan plateau, drier than Mumbai
The monsoon (June to September) is long and damp
November to February brings cool, dry mornings and nights
Sun is strong even on clear winter afternoons
